data_validation.rationale: A margin of 15.0 here is correct, but this guard catches nonsensical outputs like negative or >100% values that would slip through unchecked.

analysis_methodology.rule: When applying the Dividend Discount Model, verify that r > g (required return exceeds growth rate) before computing; if r ≤ g, the model is invalid and no finite price exists.
analysis_methodology.rationale: The DDM formula P_0 = D_1/(r-g) produces a negative or undefined result when r ≤ g, so this domain-specific guard prevents nonsensical outputs in dividend/growth scenarios.
